content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"List the available project documents, then read candidate_specs.md and any relevant Level-1 hardware/rate/trigger-allocation documents. Extract the three allowed candidate algorithms, their deployability constraints, and the allocated trigger-rate condition to be used in simulations."},{"id":"s2","description":"For each of the three candidate algorithms, run simulate_efficiency at a coarse threshold scan over the allowed range: 20, 30, 40, 50, and 60 GeV. Record the returned signal efficiency values numerically for each algorithm-threshold point."},{"id":"s3","description":"Using the coarse-scan results, identify for each deployable candidate the threshold region giving the best signal efficiency at the allocated rate. Around the best coarse threshold for each promising candidate, run a refined scan in smaller steps within 20–60 GeV, prioritizing thresholds near the highest-efficiency points."},{"id":"s4","description":"Compare all simulated algorithm-threshold points, excluding any candidate found non-deployable in Level-1 hardware or not listed in candidate_specs.md. Select the deployable candidate and threshold with the highest signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate."},{"id":"s5","description":"Submit the single recommended Level-1 trigger algorithm and threshold, including the supporting numeric efficiency result from the best simulation point and noting that the threshold is within 20–60 GeV."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Algorithm-L1","threshold_gev":36.5,"justification":"Recommend Algorithm-L1 with a 36.5 GeV threshold. Among the three allowed candidate algorithms, all of which are deployable within the Level-1 FPGA/resource and optical-link budgets, the refined threshold scan found Algorithm-L1 at 36.5 GeV gives the highest recorded signal efficiency: 92.774%. This exceeds the best refined efficiencies for Algorithm-L2 (85.224% at 37.5 GeV) and Algorithm-L3 (74.616% at 34 GeV), while staying within the allowed 20–60 GeV threshold range and the allocated Level-1 trigger-rate context of 8 kHz.","requirements":[{"requirement":"Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.","status":"met","evidence":"The overall best refined result is Algorithm-L1 at 36.5 GeV with 92.774% signal efficiency, higher than Algorithm-L2's best 85.224% and Algorithm-L3's best 74.616%; allocated_L1_rate_khz = 8 was the rate target used in the study."},{"requirement":"The algorithm must be one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.","status":"met","evidence":"num_allowed_candidate_algorithms = 3; selected_algorithm_code = 1, corresponding to Algorithm-L1, one of the listed candidates."},{"requirement":"The algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware.","status":"met","evidence":"all_candidates_fit_fpga_resource_budget = 1 and optical_links_sufficient_for_all_candidates = 1, so Algorithm-L1 is deployable in the Level-1 hardware."},{"requirement":"Threshold between 20 and 60 GeV.","status":"met","evidence":"Selected threshold is 36.5 GeV; submitted_threshold_within_20_60_gev = 1."},{"requirement":"Finish by submitting one recommended algorithm and threshold.","status":"met","evidence":"Submitted one recommendation: Algorithm-L1 with threshold 36.5 GeV."}]}
